deviations_from_card: Per the coordinator note (bank is now a closed, deny-unknown-fields wire type), the binding lives on the calibration side, not as Situation.tactics: sim/calibration.json bait_tactics[].situations = {"<character>": [situation ids]}. Case 1 therefore reads: a calibration tactic bound to situation `no-such-situation`, checked against the shipped malakor bank -> error naming bait_tactics.<id>, the situation and the character. characters/malakor/situations.json and crates/shadowrunr-types were NOT touched. Bound today: instruction-override->prompt-injection, repeat-after-me->bait-slur-request, authority-impersonation->fake-lord-dispatch, real-person-steering->roast-real-streamer, foil-made-real, seg02a-private-person: 4 of 14 reached. The plan-only reach line goes to stderr (stdout stays pure JSON) and the JSON gains a `bank_reach` object. Tests and implementation landed as ONE commit: the situations/tournament tests cannot compile without tactic_reach/TacticReach (calibration, PF-06 and CLI cases were run red on the assertion first). Coupled files beyond the write set: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/tests/cli.rs (CLI acceptance test), docs/guide/cli.md (PF-06 row/example, --plan-only bank_reach), docs/spec/contract.md (calibration schema: situations field, cross-reference rules).
